question: The simple interest on a certain principal sum at 4.5% per annum simple interest for 4(2)/(9) years is ₹8,778. Find the amount payable on the same principal sum in 2(5)/(7) years at 5.5% per annum simple interest.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective % 1 = 4.5 × (38/9) = 19% ⇒ 19% of Principal = ₹8,778 ⇒ 1% = 462

Principal (100%) = 462 × 100 = ₹46,200

Effective % 2 = 5.5 × (19/7) = 209/14 %

New Interest = 462 × (209/14) = ₹6,897

Amount = 46,200 + 6,897 = ₹53,097

**∴ The correct answer is ₹53,097.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI₁) = ₹8,778

Rate (R₁) = 4.5% = 9/2 %

Time (T₁) = 4 2/9 years = 38/9 years

Rate (R₂) = 5.5% = 11/2 %

Time (T₂) = 2 5/7 years = 19/7 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Principal (P) = ₹46,200

 

 
 R = 4.5%, T = 38/9 yrs
 SI = ₹8,778
 (19% of Principal)

 

 
 R = 5.5%, T = 19/7 yrs
 SI = ₹6,897
 Amount = ₹53,097

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI₁ = (P × R₁ × T₁) ÷ 100

⇒ 8778 = [P × (9/2) × (38/9)] ÷ 100

⇒ 8778 = (P × 19) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (8778 × 100) ÷ 19

⇒ P = 462 × 100 = 46200

⇒ Principal (P) = ₹46,200

⇒ SI₂ = (P × R₂ × T₂) ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = [46200 × (11/2) × (19/7)] ÷ 100

⇒ SI₂ = 462 × (209/14)

⇒ SI₂ = 33 × 209 = 6897

⇒ Amount = Principal + SI₂

⇒ Amount = 46200 + 6897 = 53097

**∴ The correct answer is ₹53,097.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Simple interest is calculated only on the principal amount for the entire duration. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Effective Rate Method

Instead of calculating SI using the principal each time, the effective interest percentage can be found by multiplying Rate and Time directly: Effective % = R × T.

Amount

The total sum payable at the end of the time period, which includes the original principal and the interest accrued: Amount = Principal + Interest.
